KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT_DAIMA_THIRD_EYE.title: Third Eye
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT_DAIMA_THIRD_EYE.flavo: A treasure of the Demon Realm, said to awaken dormant power.
KAKAROTMOD-SAIYAN_BLOOD.title: Saiyan Blood
KAKAROTMOD-SAIYAN_BLOOD.flavor: Every time a Saiyan crawls back from the brink, they come back stronger.
KAKAROTMOD-SAIYAN_BLOOD.description: Gain 1 extra Rage at the start of your first turn each combat. Whenever you play a Strike or take damage from an enemy, gain 1 Rage. Below 20% HP: gain 2 Strength and 2 Dexterity. End of combat: if your HP is below 70%, heal 6 HP.
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT_HEALING_POD.title: Healing Pod
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT_HEALING_POD.flavor: A few minutes in the tank and you're ready to get beaten up all over again.
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT_HEALING_POD.descripti: At the start of each combat, heal 4 HP.
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT_SPACE_SHIP.title: Saiyan Space Pod
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT_SPACE_SHIP.flavor: Standard-issue Saiyan transport. Seats one. Legroom not included.
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT_SPACE_SHIP.descriptio: The first time you play a Skill each combat, draw 2 cards.
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT_LEGENDARY_LINEAGE.fla: What does the scouter say about its power level? It's over 9000!
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT_LEGENDARY_LINEAGE.des: Gain 2 extra Rage at the start of your first turn each combat. Whenever you play a Strike or take damage from an enemy, gain 2 Rage. Max Energy +1. Below 20% HP: gain 2 Strength and 2 Dexterity. End of combat: if your HP is below 80%, heal 6 HP.
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT_CAPSULE1.title: Capsule No. 1
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT_CAPSULE1.flavor: Capsule Corp. guarantees the quality. Bulma guarantees nothing.
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT_CAPSULE1.description: When you enter a Rest Site, heal 6 HP.
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT_DRAGON_RADAR.title: Dragon Radar
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT_DRAGON_RADAR.flavor: Seven blips, one wish... and an eighth signal that definitely shouldn't be there.
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT_DRAGON_RADAR.descript: On pickup, choose 1 of 8 Shenron cards to add to your deck.
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT_SACRED_WATER_JUG.flav: Korin has been dodging grabby kids for 800 years. Good luck.
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT_SACRED_WATER_JUG.desc: The first time each turn you alternate between an Attack and a Skill, gain 1 Rage and draw 1 card. Powers do not interrupt the sequence.
